title: CoRe-TFM ChatGPT conversation recovery bundle: research artifacts not tracked in GitHub

github_crosscheck.algorithm: Git blob SHA-1 of exact file bytes, compared by first 12 hex characters to all tracked blobs in all four branches (false match probability negligible; any positives would require full-length comparison)
github_crosscheck.name_check: All distinctive NB35–NB50 and v3–v8 generated artifact names absent from the four branch trees. Generic main.tex/references.bib differ by full git-blob SHA1.

limitations: This contains conversation artifacts available in the current session. It is not a dump of every historical ChatGPT conversation outside this project.
The GitHub comparison checks branch HEADs, not unreachable past Git commits, Git LFS hidden data, private forks or content outside the repository.
Some archived snapshots are superseded and intentionally redundant; the completed 160-cache evidence is the master.
Two contaminated snapshots containing an unrelated sepsis PDF were excluded; clean equivalent results remain included.
Exact package file hashes, origins and exclusions are recorded here.
